subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action update land after refreshed current-head validation, or should the secret-bearing Codex, token, and release action changes be reviewed separately?
rationale: The patch changes third-party executable code across several privileged workflow boundaries, while the protected security label and incomplete Codex contract review require an explicit human risk decision.

options.title: Validate and land together
options.body: Rebase the PR, complete all current-head checks, verify the upstream pins and Codex contract, then approve the grouped update as one reviewed automation change.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land routine toolchain and analysis pins separately from Codex, GitHub App token, Docker login, and publishing actions so each privileged boundary receives focused proof.

options.title: Regenerate later
options.body: Close and allow Dependabot to regenerate the group if repeated rebases prevent a stable reviewed head and complete checks.

recommendation.title: Validate and land together
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, complete all current-head checks, verify the upstream pins and Codex contract, then approve the grouped update as one reviewed automation change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the release workflow and validation path with the highest consequence in this grouped update.
